## About
Roessler Equipment Company started as a commercial HVAC representative serving the greater Houston region. Charles Bradbury Roessler, known as Charlie, began out of his home, moved to an office on Louisiana Street downtown, and then bought the property on Schumacher Lane back when it was mostly a residential neighborhood. We are still at that same address, and we are still family owned and operated.
Today we represent commercial HVAC manufacturers including ABB, LAKOS, Mueller, Flow-Tech and REYMSA Cooling Towers. We have also grown beyond supplying equipment, with VFD repair, gas and refrigerant monitoring repair, cooling tower refurbishment, panel and enclosure services and training classes.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating across 45 Google reviews.

## Services
- VFD diagnostics and repair: Diagnostics, repairs, preventative maintenance and soft charging for variable frequency drives.
- ABB VFD installations and start-ups: Installation and start-up of ABB variable frequency drives.
- Gas detection: Start-ups, diagnostics and repairs for gas detection devices.
- Chemical free water treatment: We provide, install and service Flow Tech chemical free water treatment, which replaces costly and hazardous chemicals and allows for water and energy savings.
- Panel and enclosure services: We provide panel and enclosure services to our clients.
- Cooling tower refurbishment: Refurbishment work for commercial cooling towers.
- Items in stock: We stock thousands of items to serve your immediate needs.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule a technician?
A: Contact our team by phone or at Sales@recohvac.com for technical assistance or to set up a service visit.

Q: Do you hold classes?
A: Yes. We offer VFD training classes, and one reviewer mentions that we host free classes on mechanical topics.
